column1: # Proteins that differ between the antibiotic-tolerant (PrpoS) and the growing (Ptrc) subpopulation of a Pseudomonas aeruginosa PA14 biofilm, labeled in the tolerant region by cell-selective bioorthogonal noncanonical amino acid tagging and quantified by LC-MS/MS

# Babin BM, Atangcho L, van Eldijk MB, Sweredoski MJ, Moradian A, Hess S, Tolker-Nielsen T, Newman DK, Tirrell DA. 2017. Selective proteomic analysis of antibiotic-tolerant cellular subpopulations in Pseudomonas aeruginosa biofilms. mBio 8(5):e01593-17. https://doi.org/10.1128/mBio.01593-17
# Source: Data Set S1 (mbo005173553sd1.xlsx, sheet "sheet1"), the PrpoS versus Ptrc enrichment comparison (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC5654934/supplementaryFiles)

# Cutoff: the paper's own significance call, FDR-adjusted P < 0.05 on the median log2 ratio; 39 of the 908 quantified proteins pass (15 more abundant, 24 less abundant), the same proteins the paper lists in Tables S1 and S2; all kept
# Licensed CC BY 4.0; values as published

# Columns: locus_tag = PA01 Locus ID as published; gene = Gene Name as published; uniprot = the protein in the species index (by PAO1 locus tag, or by blastp best hit of the PA14 protein against the index at >= 90% identity and >= 90% coverage of both sequences); median_log2_ratio and adj_p as published; direction = sign of the ratio
